items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against the tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch muss binnen eines Monats nach der Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Beispielgüstrow eingehen, schriftlich, über das Portal ELSTER oder mündlich zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The notice is dated Wed 18.11.2026 and was sent by post. Current § 122 Abs. 2 Satz 1 AO (as also stated in the letter) deems a posted notice delivered on the 4th day after posting. Day of posting = 18.11.2026 (Wed); 18.11.2026 + 4 days = 22.11.2026, which is a Sunday. Per § 108 Abs. 3 AO (fictional delivery day falling on a Sat/Sun/holiday moves to the next working day), the fictional Bekanntgabe shifts to Monday 23.11.2026. The one-month Einspruch period of § 355 AO begins the day after Bekanntgabe (§ 108 Abs. 1 AO i.V.m. § 187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. 24.11.2026, and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event (23.11.2026) — i.e. 23.12.2026. That date is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, so it stands as the final day the Einspruch must reach the Finanzamt.
